posts.author: Ghonarbochon
posts.text: No.Non renewal of peer review is clearly mentioned as the reason for resignation. It means that the erstwhile auditors peer review certificate has not been renewed making them ineligible to continue .Unless an audit farm has it, they can’t legally operate as an auditor and actually SEBI also mandates that statutory auditors must have peer review certificate when auditing listed companies.So that resignation is actually a forced resignation because of professional non-compliance of the auditors themselves.Nothing much to do with Piccadily .
